name: Sam Placeholder
headline: I'm a career changer learning web development, and I build small websites for local shops.
bio: I was a baker for eight years. I got into coding when I built a website for the bakery during a quiet winter, and I loved that I could make something people use every day.
Now I'm learning JavaScript in the evenings and working as a freelance web helper for shops in my town.

projects.title: Bakery Opening Hours
projects.description: A page that shows whether the bakery is open right now.

experience.summary: Building small websites for local shops.
